  PROBLEM: `rb_security_findings_render` inserts unconstrained finding IDs into issue titles and the judge prompt without an untrusted-data fence.

- scripts/review_rb_judge_security_pass.sh:160-173; scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2095-2097 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When the extension marker comment write fails, `rb_security_post_extension` warns and returns 0, and the caller proceeds to record `judge_handled=true`.
  WHY: The next review can re-enter security-exhaustion mode and bypass the merge gate, allowing the pushed fix to merge without the promised audit cycle.
- scripts/review_rb_judge_security_pass.sh:80-85 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: API or JSON-parse failures write an unavailable-findings note but return success.
  WHY: The judge can proceed in security-exhaustion mode without the findings data, and the merge gate is skipped.
- Requirement: "Each such fix posts a `<!-- ai:single-issue-security-pass-extension:v1 head=<sha> -->` marker that grants one more audit cycle, so the fix is audited before the PR can merge." (PR description, point 2)
  Expected change site: scripts/review_rb_judge_security_pass.sh `rb_security_post_extension` (line 160-173) and its call site at scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2095-2097
  Evidence of absence: The mechanism that grants the extra cycle is the comment write; when the write fails, the function only logs a `::warning::` (line 171) and returns 0. No fall-back (e.g. fail-closed at the call site, or the gate refusing to mark the pass "not exhausted" when extensions=0 but a recent `[judge-fix]` push is present) preserves the "fix is audited before the PR can merge" guarantee. The unit test `test_extension_marker_failure_only_warns` codifies the fail-open behaviour as intended, but the test was written before the runtime consequence (next review re-enters security-exhaustion and the gate is bypassed) was traced through end-to-end. Result: the audit guarantee is conditional on a single `gh api` call succeeding, with no observable failure path that holds the merge.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "a PR whose security audit runs out of cycles now goes to the review-blocked judge instead of waiting for a human" (PR description, headline) — security-exhaustion mode listing open `[security-audit]` findings for the branch
  Expected change site: scripts/review_rb_judge_security_pass.sh `rb_security_findings_render` (line 77-97)
  Evidence of absence: The function issues one `gh api …/issues?labels=ai:security&state=open&per_page=100` without `--paginate` (line 80), in contrast to `scripts/security_audit.sh:1721-1724` which explicitly paginates this same set. A repository with >100 open `ai:security` issues is silently truncated to the first page; the judge decides on an incomplete list. The test at `tests/test_review_rb_judge_security_pass.py:131-138` only covers 3 issues, so the gap is not asserted.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
